title: Rounding and multi-step problems - 123 school
heading: Rounding and multi-step problems
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
All the data you need is in the question. Every question tells you how to round. For a multi-step problem, the tip tells you how many steps you need.

A solution has a concentration of 0.80 g/L. How many grams of dissolved substance are there in 250 mL of this solution? Round to 2 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
A liquid has a density of 0.92 g/mL. What is the volume in L of 150 g of this liquid? Round to 3 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.

You have 100 mL of water with a density of 1.00 g/mL. The molar mass is 18.0 g/mol. How many moles of water is that? Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 1.00 g/mL × 100 mL = 100 g. Step 2: 100 g ÷ 18.0 g/mol = 5.6 mol

questions.q: You have 2.5 mol of a substance with a molar mass of 44.0 g/mol. How many kg is that? Round to 3 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 2.5 mol × 44.0 g/mol = 110 g. Step 2: 110 g = 0.110 kg

questions.q: How many mL of solution are needed to dissolve 0.15 mol if the concentration must be 0.50 mol/L? Round to a whole number. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 0.15 mol ÷ 0.50 mol/L = 0.30 L. Step 2: 0.30 L = 300 mL

questions.q: A cyclist covers 18 km in 45 minutes. What is the average speed in km/h? Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 45 min = 0.75 h. Step 2: 18 km ÷ 0.75 h = 24.0 km/h

questions.q: A 60 W lamp is on for 5 hours. How many kWh of energy does the lamp use? (1 kW = 1000 W) Round to 2 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 60 W = 0.060 kW. Step 2: 0.060 kW × 5 h = 0.30 kWh

questions.q: You mix 150 mL of water (1.00 g/mL) with 60 mL of ethanol (0.79 g/mL). What is the total mass of the mixture in grams? Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 1.00 g/mL × 150 mL = 150 g of water and 0.79 g/mL × 60 mL = 47.4 g of ethanol. Step 2: 150 g + 47.4 g = 197.4 g

questions.q: You have 40 mL of ethanol with a density of 0.79 g/mL. The molar mass is 46.0 g/mol. How many moles of ethanol is that? Round to 2 decimal places. Tip: this is a 2-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: 0.79 g/mL × 40 mL = 31.6 g. Step 2: 31.6 g ÷ 46.0 g/mol = 0.69 mol

questions.q: You mix 150 mL of water (1.00 g/mL) with 60 mL of ethanol (0.79 g/mL). Calculate the mass percentage of water in the mixture. Round to 1 decimal place. Tip: this is a 3-step problem. Only round the final answer.
questions.e: Step 1: mass of water = 150 g and mass of ethanol = 47.4 g. Step 2: total mass = 197.4 g. Step 3: 150 g ÷ 197.4 g × 100% = 76.0%
